cards.title: Business Problem
cards.subtitle: Procure-to-Pay Performance & Accounts Payable Cockpit
cards.description: Procurement, goods receipt, supplier delivery and accounts payable information can be difficult to assess when each process is reviewed separately. Decision-makers need a consistent view of purchasing value, receipt progress, invoice status and outstanding payables to identify areas requiring follow-up.

cards.title: Three Key Business Questions
cards.subtitle: Procure-to-Pay Performance & Accounts Payable Cockpit
cards.description: How are purchase order value, goods receipt value and invoice amount performing across fiscal periods and material groups? Which suppliers contribute most to procurement value, and where are delivery quantities or delivery statuses requiring attention? What is the current invoice and accounts payable position by supplier and payment status?
